1.

Product Overview

Automated vehicle access control engineered to regulate and secure every entry and exit point.

Boom Barriers are automated vehicle access control systems designed to regulate and secure entry and exit points.

They are widely used in parking areas, residential societies, commercial buildings, industrial premises, warehouses, factories and toll/access points.

Boom barriers can be integrated with RFID, access cards, ANPR cameras, remote controls and other access control systems for fully automated vehicle management.

Vehicle Control

Regulates entry and exit at high-traffic access points.

Integration Ready

Works with RFID, ANPR cameras and access cards.

Fast Operation

Rapid-action arm cycles for high-traffic throughput.

Site Flexibility

Straight, folding and telescopic arm configurations.
